links.outcome: Readability and layperson comprehension of GPT-4 plain-language summaries versus original IR reports
links.effect: FKRL improved from 10.7 to 7.0 and FRES from 41.9 to 73.0; layperson comprehension rose significantly from 2.5 to 4.3 out of 5.
links.quote: Layperson comprehension scores improved significantly from 2.5 to 4.3 out of 5 after summarization.

unlisted_practices: Using an LLM to translate simplified procedural reports into multiple languages, with bilingual clinician accuracy review

screen.reason: Evaluates GPT-4 for simplifying and translating interventional radiology reports for layperson/patient comprehension without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
